codes.evidence_quote: Presupuestos para una teoría gitano-morisca del flamenco
codes.rationale: The passage frames flamenco through a historical-origin theory that seeks roots and continuity between Andalusian music, Moriscos, and Gypsies.

codes.evidence_quote: el estudioso cuenta hoy con uno de los trabajos más interesantes y rigurosos de la bibliografía flamenca
codes.target: Blas Infante's reconstructed book on flamenco origins
codes.rationale: The text explicitly evaluates the scholarly work as interesting and rigorous within flamenco bibliography.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: Gypsies and Moriscos are discussed as identity groups, but the visible text mainly develops historical comparison and origin theory rather than clearly assigning present flamenco authority or belonging through identity.

derived_analysis.target: a gitano-morisco origin theory of flamenco and Blas Infante's work

annotation_notes: Truncated article; coded only visible origin-theory and evaluation passages.

codes.evidence_quote: diversos medios de difusión y algunos informadores mal informados, han dicho... que ha sido la primera vez que un guitarrista flamenco lo ha grabado, y no es así
codes.target: claims that Paco de Lucía was the first flamenco guitarist to record or perform the Concierto de Aranjuez
codes.rationale: The author exercises corrective critical authority by rejecting misinformed public accounts and asserting the accurate flamenco-historical record.

codes.evidence_quote: Luis López Tejera es el decano de la sonanta, ha honrado a Andalucía y en general a España
codes.rationale: The passage canonizes Luis Maravilla through exemplary status, seniority, and national/regional honor.

codes.evidence_quote: ¿No sería justo que por la Consejería de Cultura de la Junta de Andalucía, se hiciesen las gestiones necesarias... en forma de justo homenaje?
codes.rationale: The passage calls on a public cultural institution to authorize and recognize the artist through an official homage.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: There is extensive praise of Luis Maravilla, but CRIT_03 and CRIT_04 more specifically capture the canonizing and corrective functions of the article.

derived_analysis.target: Luis Maravilla and the historical record of flamenco guitar performance

annotation_notes: The article both legitimates Luis Maravilla and delegitimates inaccurate public reporting.
